title: Horror 3D
description: A first-person horror game in the style of Slender: collect the pages scattered through a dark forest before the thing hunting you catches up. Pawel Jarosz's entry to Made With Defold Jam 2023.
author: Pawel Jarosz
controls: WASD move, Shift run, Space jump, C crouch, F flashlight, mouse look, N disables scare jumps, 1/2 adjust brightness.
credits: Based on Illumination by Roman Silin (astrochili), MIT, and Horri-fold post-processing by Aayush Kashyap (TheKing0x9).
Models from cgtrader free models: low-poly zombie, dead trees, realistic trees pack, metal door, cross stone, candles set, meatcube arm; each is credited by link in the project README.
Depends on defold-operator and defold-trenchbroom (Roman Silin), pigeon (Pawel Jarosz) and defold-pointer-lock (Indiesoft LLC).
notes: pointer_lock (indiesoftby/defold-pointer-lock) is replaced by cart-ext/pointer_lock: the original locks the cursor through GLFW or the browser, neither of which a cart has. Its Lua half is unchanged.
